ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Somali Day Care Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of the Somali day care fraud scandal, including the amount of money involved and the individuals or organizations responsible.
questions: How much money is involved in the Somali day care fraud scandal?
Who are the key individuals or organizations responsible?
ideas.insight: I believe this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the financial mismanagement of federal funds. By following the money trail, we can identify the key players and expose the extent of the fraud.
